description: This file defines a ViewModel class named 'BaseActivityViewModel' for an Android application, which manages UI-related data in a lifecycle conscious way. It contains logic for tracking UI actions, specifically related to floating action button (FAB) actions and refresh tasks, and interacts with the 'BaseActivity' class for managing tracker listeners.

classes.name: BaseActivityViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel subclass managing FAB actions and refresh tasks, handling lifecycle-aware data updates and listener registration.

classes.name: BaseActivityViewModel.FabAction
classes.description: An enum representing actions 'Show' and 'Hide' for the floating action button.

methods.name: BaseActivityViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing LiveData objects, setting up a listener to update refresh tasks, and registering the listener with BaseActivity.

methods.name: actOnFab
methods.description: Triggers a change in FAB visibility by updating the LiveData value.

methods.name: getFabActions
methods.description: Returns LiveData publishing the current FAB action state.

methods.name: getRefresh
methods.description: Returns LiveData that publishes refresh task updates.

methods.name: onCleared
methods.description: Called when ViewModel is being destroyed; removes the tracker listener to prevent leaks.
